content: Previous researches shows that letter n-grams are very efficient for classifying text. They are language independent and does not require expensive text pre-processing techniques like tokenization, stemming and stop words removal, hence in the case of code-mix texts, this could yield good results BIBREF16 , BIBREF17 . Since the number of n-grams can be very large we took trigrams which occur more than ten times in the corpus.
